caption: An extreme close-up frames a person's hand with fingers extended upward against a dark, out-of-focus gray background. A three-stone ring sits on the ring finger, its white-metal band holding a larger round center stone flanked by two smaller round stones in prong settings. The hand remains essentially in place, showing only small positional and rotational adjustments as the ring and finger edges shift slightly within the frame. Bright starburst specular reflections flash intermittently across the stones rather than continuously, sweeping from the right to the center, then the left, and recurring on different facets. The overall view drifts a little, consistent with minor camera or hand motion, while the dominant activity is this shifting sparkle pattern. The ring's three-stone layout and the finger it occupies stay constant, with no deformation or new object entering the scene.
relations: Small hand rotation shifts light angles, making starburst reflections flash intermittently across the prong-set stones.
The extended finger against the gray background allows slight view drift while the ring's three-stone layout stays constant.
Positional adjustments move sparkle from right to center to left as facets catch changing light.
